svg.title: URTC-VISION-TOOL architecture
svg.desc: URTC-VISION-TOOL holds the sensor protocol of the firmware (a versioned frame with a CRC-8, range, rate and freshness checks and diagnostic counters, in pure C) and the vision_companion package, which reads a thermal image from a URTC head over CAN, aligns it with the RGB image, judges the components of a plan and the tips of a tool rack by temperature, and exports the readings. No board exists yet; everything is tested on a computer against simulated heads.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A thermal and RGB inspection head: the sensor protocol of its firmware and a Python companion that judges what the cameras see.
